primary.title: How to Fine-Tune Models Beyond Cosmos With NVIDIA Cosmos Framework
primary.summary: NVIDIA Cosmos Framework now supports fine-tuning models beyond the Cosmos family. In this tutorial, learn how to fine-tune Qwen3-VL for robot video question answering with NVIDIA Cosmos Framework and agent skills. Follow the RoboVQA recipe from environment setup and data preparation through preflight checks, baseline evaluation, training, and model export. See how a coding agent runs the workflow from a single prompt, then compare the base and fine-tuned models’ answers on a held-out robot clip. Get started with Cosmos Framework: ⚙️ Get the code and recipes → github.com/NVIDIA/cosmos/blob/main
